name: Mushroom dome retreat & Land of paradise suite
description: Previously known as the Mushroom Dome Cabin, (Permit number 241029) we have been listing the LAND of Paradise Suite & the Mushroom Dome Retreat with airbnb since July '09 and have had the most reservations of any of their listings. There is a reason we are so popular: the cabin is near a Redwood Grove, and at night, there is hardly any sound here - maybe  crickets. It is a Paradise here: a great place to unwind & restore.
neighborhood_overview:
Even though we live only an 8-10 minute drive to Aptos village and the beaches, as we live on 10 acres, it feels very remote and private here. It is usually very quiet at night - sometimes we can hear the ocean waves crashing on the beach. There is lots of land to hike on and explore here as well.
We have 9 people living here in a rather loose community.
host_about:
We live on 10 beautiful acres of sun, oak forest, redwood groves and gardens with a parrot, 2 cats, a small dog, 12 chickens and from 200 - 500 hummingbirds - depending on the time of year..  

I have been hosting on airbnb since July, 2009 and really love what this company has made possible. I have met so many wonderful people from around the world that I would never have met if I hadn't had this opportunity with airbnb! Some of our guests (especially the ones from Europe) have never seen a hummingbird before and here they get to see them up close - just a few feet from them as the birds "hum" around the feeders.

We welcome you to come experience the peace and tranquility that our wonderful land has to offer.

name: Guest Cottage with shared bath
description:
30 day minimum
Tiny garden cottage with a small kitchenette and small sleeping loft with a full futon. This is a very cute, very cozy space -- perfect for a single person or a couple. The loft has a low ceiling -- think ship's bunk. .
Bathroom in main house (the cottage does not have its own bathroom).
There's a 30 night min/max to stay in compliance with County rules but longer stays are also an option.
We have cats and dogs. Visiting pets are welcome but there's a fee.
host_about:
I am an over employed PA in love with the country life. The property is a rambling half acre of flowers, vegetable gardens an fruit trees in the hilly setting of South Santa Cruz County. Large sunny decks flank the main house and invite guests outside to enjoy morning coffee and the New York Times. 
The house has a small downstairs bedroom with shared bath. There is also a much larger private suite of rooms upstairs (that is not listed).  The guest cottage is quite small but cozy and is sited under the trees at the bottom of the rose garden. It has a small kitchenette and shares the downstairs bathroom in the main house. Both the bedroom and the cottage have queen sized futons. The cottage sleeping loft is a short ladder climb up. Either space would be perfect for a couple. We can accommodate up to three couples, with children. Well behaved dogs are also welcome and guests are encouraged to cook in the main house in the country-style kitchen with oak floors and an antique gas stove . 
The outdoor spaces offer benches and tables to sit, read and even eat out doors. And the wood fired hot tub is quite popular. I especially love soaking under the stars....
I serve coffee in the morning if I am home and not working out of town.

By profession I am a principal in a Landscape Architecture firm (www.EarthArchDesign.com).  In my "previous life" I was a Veterinary Nurse and spent some time restoring historic homes. I currently reside in a historic town in the Santa Cruz Mountains, where I have a spacious property with Victorian Guest Cottages that I share with travelers.  I grow most of my own organic heirloom vegetables on the property and love to share gardening tips!
What is it like to have me as a host?  I've been told that coming to my property is like stepping back in time and is the perfect place to rejuvenate the spirit.  Guests have also appreciated having their own cottage and the privacy that comes with it.  Because I am very involved in my community, I can also give lots of tips on where to go and what to do depending on the desires of the guest.

name: Ridge Top Get-A-Way and Quiet Dedicated work space
description:
Permit 231319
A quiet, private suite in a stunning ridgetop setting—perfect for relaxation and renewal!

This spacious guest suite features two bedrooms, a private spa bathroom, and a secluded deck, private, occupying the entire lower floor of our hilltop home. Enjoy breathtaking forest views and peaceful, star-filled nights, just 20 minutes from Silicon Valley and Monterey Bay's beaches. Guests have their own private entrance and convenient off-street parking.
neighborhood_overview: What we love about our neighborhood is that we don't live in a neighborhood. Our house sits on a sunny hilltop surrounded by the Redwood forest with the closest neighbor's house a couple hundred yards away.  While we live in a rural area, Silicon Valley is 15-20 minutes to the north and Monterey Bay is 15 minutes to the south, great for business and pleasure. Levi Stadium is 40 minutes away. Motorcyclists will love this location, lots of great day rides to enjoy.
host_about:

Empty twisty back roads, a firm suspension, and a good apex makes my motor rev. Uncrowded steeps covered in feet  of fluffy powder, blue sky, and mountain vistas are my favorite things. Hanging out with friends at our outdoor bar, drinking, eating, talking, laughing, enjoying the evening, reveling in the beauty that surrounds us. 

We offer a private guest suite (1 or 2 rooms), in a quite, beautiful setting. A romantic get-away, relaxing weekend, a place at the bar after a day of mountain biking, a family vacation adventure or whatever you choose, we'll do our best to accommodate your needs and style. name: Jade Studio by Beach at Jasmine Garden Oasis
description: Jasmine Garden Oasis Retreat House—3 block walk to quiet beaches. Ideal for individuals, couples, or families seeking serenity. SC Permit # 231326. Two upstairs independent guest studios inside our home, each with queen bed and extra beds for $25 charge: Jade Studio with private deck, and Birdsong Studio overlooking garden and hot tub. Meditation & QiGong instruction, bicycle rental nearby, allergy-free, healing sessions, low-EMFs--renewing for heart, body & soul. Sunrise/sunset at beach.
neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood is a relatively quiet neighborhood with an assortment of people who enjoy living near the beach--including long-time residents, families, retired people, UCSC students, and surfers interspersed to keep it characteristic of Santa Cruz.
Two blocks away is a modest shopping center which hosts the local farmer's market on Sunday mornings. A handful of eateries and a coffee shop, from fast food to upscale dining, line the two blocks toward the beaches. A back way to the beach (our special secret) is three lovely blocks, two of which are walking/biking trails, one lined with Cypress trees, and the next along a lagoon lined with Eucalyptus trees.
The Harbor and Crows Nest restaurant and nightclub are a several blocks to the west along the shore. Downtown Santa Cruz is 3 miles west and Capitola, a quaint seaside town, is 2 miles east. Both are easily accessible by bike lanes, public transportation and car.
host_about: We, Peter & Marie, are a married couple who relish offering our sweet space & location to guests. We enjoy living in a tranquil atmosphere and want to share this with others of like mind at our home, Jasmine Garden Oasis Retreat House near the Sea. It is a modest home tucked away in a modest neighborhood three blocks from the beach in east Santa Cruz with two independent Airbnb studios upstairs, and expand to include the whole house when we offer guided retreats. We keep gentle gardens and cosy comfortable atmosphere for people who want a time of  renewal for body and soul. Often we enjoy the short tree-lined walk to visit the quiet beach and listen to the surf,  especially at dawn and dusk. We welcome our Airbnb guests to join us early mornings with either QiGong or meditation in the garden or at the nearby lagoon. We have a list of healing artists who have offered to deliver their services to our guests in their private rooms or in the garden.

Enjoy the vibrant life here. In your own little oasis, enjoy the Hummingbirds flying outside your window and the beautiful views we offer from your large private patio or from the deck. neighborhood_overview:
The guests that we have had in the Hummingbird Haven & the Mushroom Dome Cabin are amazed by the quiet and peaceful nature of our area. At night, you will hear lots of crickets, maybe an owl or a tree frog and sometimes the ocean waves crashing in the distance. In the summer, you can see the Milky Way as we are far enough away from city lights that, on a clear night, you can see quite a lot of stars.
The Monterey Bay is one of the most vibrate marine sanctuaries in the world - sometimes hosting the largest gathering of marine mammals in the world. We have various whales here year round with whale watching tours daily. Check out our reviews of the Mushroom Dome Cabin to get feedback from our guests of our property. If you plan ahead, you can have a larger group here by reserving both spaces.
We also have a metal geodesic dome climbing structure, a small netted trampoline and a tiny playhouse for kids to play with.
host_about:
We live on 10 beautiful acres of sun, oak forest, redwood groves and gardens with a parrot, 2 cats, a small dog, 12 chickens and from 200 - 500 hummingbirds - depending on the time of year..

I have met so many wonderful people from around the world that I would never have met if I hadn't had this opportunity with airbnb! Some of our guests (especially the ones from Europe) have never seen a hummingbird before and here they get to see them up close - just a few feet from them as the birds "hum" around the feeders.

We welcome you to come experience the peace and tranquility that our wonderful land has to offer.

neighborhood_overview:
The house is centrally located to all the attractions in Santa Cruz.
Three miles away is the main attraction in Santa Cruz, the California Beach Boardwalk. The boardwalk has rides, events and attractions right on the beach. One mile away is Twin Lakes Beach. There you will find the Yacht Harbor, which offers beach volleyball, kayaks rentals and wonderful restaurants also on the beach. Two miles in the opposite direction is Capitola. Capitola is a quaint beach town, with many restaurants and boutique shops. Pleasure Point, which is a popular surf area and 41st Ave, which is filled with restaurants and surf shops, is 1 mile away.
Santa Cruz is apart of the Monterey Bay, which has endless possibilities for sight seeing. One of the most popular is the Monterey Bay Aquarium in Monterey and Carmel, which is 45 miles away.

host_about: We are the Talbot family. We bought our vacation home when our kids were 9 and 12. We wanted a place we could enjoy the beach, but also share that experience with others like you.  We wanted to embrace the Santa Cruz lifestyle with a beach house-style home.    I was born and raised in Hawaii, and I wanted a home away from home. So the island decor fits perfectly with the house location to the surf, beach, and the Aloha Grill down the street.  Our kids love the bunk beds, and we made one of the rooms into a surfer decor to bring the Santa Cruz surf style to life. The beach, which is a short walk away, was perfect for beach lovers alike. neighborhood_overview:
Our Farmhouse was built in 1932 during a thriving area for Live Oak as the crown jewel of hens and egg production. The chickens are gone but their history has left us with rich fertile soil where we have taken advantage of this resource to plant a flourishing garden.

Live Oak and Santa Cruz raised the second most number of chickens in the State after Petaluma, in the heyday of egg production in the first half of the 20th century. Chanticleer Ave is named after the Chanticleer Rooster, and Live Oak was the epicenter, being the location of the local Farmer’s Exchange, an enterprise modeled after the mid west member-owned Co-ops. Two trains a day brought ingredients for chicken feed to the Exchange and they were milled and blended into feed for the members.

Live Oak is rich in history and we welcome you to explore our quiet neighborhood and discover all kinds of wonderful hidden gems.

host_about:
I am a happily retired Marriage and Family Therapist.   My life therefore has been about relationships that matter. 
     I am a photographer.  I love travel and color and the combination of both is  ideal for me.  
     I love hosting couples, groups of women as well as their family members. I g love their complete immersion into the pleasure of our home and its' surrounding areas.  I love my reviews when people "get it" when it comes to our  beach home.  It's fun to hear they spent time trying to imagine the stories that went behind each segment  of decor.    I LOVE France, and then Italy, and Morocco.  Canada is up there too, because they speak French (even though I don't). 
    I also fancy myself a chef (colorful, tasteful, healthy food).   Don't forget to check out all the cookbooks and international magazines.   You will know that I love cooking when you see our custom designed kitchen, the myriad of cooking utensils, french door refrigerator, Viking Stove and Bosch Dishwasher.   The french doors off the dining area open out  to extend your eating areas and invite you for morning  a cup of coffee outside.   The french doors off the living room invite you to watch the fog roll away under the palm tree.  This is yet another thing I love. 
       Walt and I have been married for 35 years.  He is still in practice as a psychologist and has taught mindfulness meditation for about 30 years.  He is the quiet type but rarely sits still.
     Interior design with elegance, color, history and a sense of whimsy would well describe another of my passions.  I like changing things up from time to time so my return guests get to do it all over again.  I love exploring our area for new things for us to do as well as always keep it fun for our guests and their children.  As nice as the house is I encourage everyone to get out there and enjoy  the outside and outlying areas as well.  Nicene Marks is almost within walking distance   The beach is a short stroll.
        I like establishing a relationship with my guests before they arrive, so I know what they need and they know what I appreciate in a guest.  People ask me, "how can you let strangers come in to this lovely home"?  Oddly, its not a problem.  To me our home is not a typical rental.  It is a shared lovely home and I think my guests understand that and feel honored to be there.  They want to maintain our relationship and so do I.
     You will get a feel for my passions as you sit on the couch in front of the fireplace, or on one of the many decks and peruse the books on design, photography, cooking and sweet novels that take place on or near the beach.
  I say to you welcome, come be an honored guest.  Wouldn't like to be my "first" Air bnb guest?

description:

host_about:
Hello! 

Welcome to my Aptos beach house. A little bit about me...

I spent 15 years living and working overseas with my family in Morocco, Lithuania, and Costa Rica. I returned to California in 2015 and fell in love with Aptos and the Monterey Bay for its beautiful beaches, mountains, and access to the San Francisco Bay Area. As a beach lover, surfer, runner, and hiker, I found Aptos to be the perfect spot to enjoy nature, the beach, and the mountains all with having quick access to San Francisco to see a Giant's baseball game or to head into Oakland or Berkeley for Ethiopian, Greek, or Indian food, to see a show, or hike in the hills. 

I love adventure travel and do most of my traveling with my kids so I understand what parents are looking for in a vacation - ease and simplicity, memory making, less time in the car and more time doing fun things together, etc.  I believe that showing children the world as often and as early as possible is important. 

“Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness, and many of our people need it sorely on these accounts. Broad, wholesome, charitable views of men and things cannot be acquired by vegetating in one little corner of the earth all one's lifetime.” - Mark Twain

I hope you enjoy my beach home and hope that you are able to explore, learn, enjoy life's simple pleasures, and make lasting memories there.

Warmly,
Sarah

name: Redwood Retreat - 191203
description:
Rustic Redwood Cabin - Tranquil Getaway

Escape to our remote, rustic cabin surrounded by Redwoods. Relax on the spacious deck or by the indoor woodstove ($50 fee/2-nite). Perfect for guests seeking peace and quiet.

Please Note:

Respect neighbors and follow house rules/no trespassing.

As as courtesy to our small, tightknit community, all neighbors are notified of guest count and arrival/departure dates. Neighbors properties have surveillance on their property and shared roads to alert them of trespassers. [Penal Code 602 PC - Trespassers will be prosecuted. The offense is a misdemeanor that carries a maximum sentence of 6 months in jail and a fine of $1000.00.]

Cabin is in the middle of a Redwood Forest surrounded by working cattle ranch with nearby and visible neighbors who take trespassing very seriously. Private road to our cabin it to only be used for accessing cabin via auto, IT IS NOT A WALKING TRAIL FOR AIRBNB GUESTS. It also can have neighbors' unfriendly dogs on it. Cows are not to be disturbed or approached.

Like any rural neighborhood, you will hear noises including dogs, roosters, chickens, ducks, chain saws, generators, blowers, tractors, trucks, distant shooting practice, visitors in travel trailers and RV's and tents etc.
host_about: My co host, Matt, and I look forward to hosting a quiet retreat for guests who can be respectful to our neighbors.  I greatly appreciate guests with strong communication and believe it is the key to making the whole Airbnb experience pleasant and smooth for everyone.  My dream is that guests will return over and over again and share the cabin with their family and friends and make memories over the years.

name: Whiskey Hollow A-Frame: As feat'd in Condé Nast!
description: Featured in Condé Nast's "30 Cozy A-Frame Cabins for Cold-Weather Getaways", Whiskey Hollow is a romantic retreat!  View majestic Redwoods from the loft bed, luxuriate in the oversized bathtub by candlelight, cozy up in front of the wood fireplace,  or cook a meal in the fully appointed kitchen.  Nestled in the woods, you would never guess that it's only 2 miles to downtown Felton, 1.5 miles to Henry Cowell State Park, 15 min to downtown Santa Cruz, and 20 min to the beach (Permit #191282).
neighborhood_overview:
If vacation means not cooking, downtown Felton offers multiple dining opportunities just five minutes away. A few of our favorites: Cowboy Bar & Grill, Sushi San, and Redwood Pizza . Scotts Valley is about 15 minutes away and offers all the amenities of a city (in case you're craving a fancy cupcake, See's candy or want to catch a movie on the big screen). Drive a few more minutes and you're in Santa Cruz at the beach, where you can find fresh crab, locally roasted coffee (Verve!), and a vegan bakery, as well as the renowned Bookshop Santa Cruz--a must if you are a book lover.

Nearby activities include hiking, surfing, zip-lining, mountain biking, and Roaring Camp Railroad. In the cabin you will find a binder filled with our dining recommendations (as well as addresses, phone numbers and hours for each restaurant), information on local activities ranging from Pescadero down to Carmel, and books about the area to help you plan your stay.

name: Cozy house in trendy West side of Santa Cruz.
description:
This is our home which we make available for guests only during part of the summer.
It is located on the West side of Santa Cruz within walking distance of the vibrant new breweries, cafes and bakeries.
The iconic West Cliff Road that hugs the cliffs by the sea are just a short walk away.

One of the most popular breweries in Santa Cruz are also walking distance (Humble Sear Brewing Co and Santa Cruz Mountain Brewing are just a couple of examples). You have the very popular Verve Coffee Roasters for your coffee, and for groceries you have a Safeway and a New Leaf Market.
Santa Cruz city center is 10 minutes drive away.

name: Lower Westside Sanctuary by Natural Bridges  Beach
description:
From our family of beach bums to yours: welcome to our newly remodeled, coastal sanctuary on the quiet lower Westside of Santa Cruz. Stroll 5 minutes to Natural Bridges Beach by day. By night, stargaze from the hot tub or gather around the gas fire pit.

Wildlife abounds: from our resident hummingbirds and butterflies at home to occasional seal, otter and whale sightings at Natural Bridges. Hungry/thirsty? Stroll 10 minutes to the heart of Santa Cruz’s beer, wine, and foodie scene!
neighborhood_overview:
The lower Westside of Santa Cruz is a quiet, family-friendly haven that's still close to all the action. It's just a 5-minute walk to Natural Bridges Beach and State Park, which is known for its wildlife, including shore birds, migratory whales, seals and otters. Not to mention the Monarch Butterfly Sanctuary at the Park—visit in late October and into November to observe peak monarch migration.

I hope you enjoy my neighborhood as much as I do!

description: Family-friendly oceanview home at Pleasure Point. This inviting retreat offers a backyard play area, including a water table and climbing structure for the little ones. neighborhood_overview:
Pleasure Point in Santa Cruz is a captivating coastal destination that embodies the essence of California beach culture. Located along the scenic Monterey Bay, this vibrant neighborhood offers a unique blend of natural beauty and laid-back charm.

Pleasure Point is renowned for its world-class surf breaks, attracting surfers from all over the globe. Watch in awe as skilled riders carve through the waves, showcasing their talent and creating an exhilarating spectacle. The rhythmic crashing of the surf and the salty ocean breeze create a mesmerizing atmosphere that embodies the spirit of the ocean.

Beyond its renowned surf spots, Pleasure Point offers breathtaking coastal views and picturesque landscapes. Take a leisurely stroll along East Cliff Drive, where you can admire the stunning vistas of the Pacific Ocean and take in the sights and sounds of this coastal paradise. The coastal path is perfect for biking, jogging, or simply enjoying a peaceful sunset walk.
host_about: My wife, Wendy, and I came to the Monterey Bay Area to work as educators at local schools. I now dedicate my time helping others enjoy our area as much as we do and Wendy continues working with students with special needs. We love meeting new people, learning about cultures, and traveling. We have two little ones that light up our life and we want to show them the world.

Nestled in oak-studded landscape and only a short drive to downtown Los Gatos and the Town Plaza Park, this open concept floor plan property features a cul-de-sac lot in the luxurious Riva Ridge area.

In addition to the 5 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, the home's lower level also features a bar and entertainment area.
neighborhood_overview:
Los Gatos is known for its affluent community, picturesque setting at the base of the Santa Cruz Mountains, quaint downtown with unique shops and restaurants, and numerous outdoor recreational opportunities including the Los Gatos Creek Trail and Vasona Lake County Park.

The presence of parks, a zoo, and historic attractions make Los Gatos a great place for families.

Los Gatos also features a vibrant cultural scene with wineries, museums, and annual events, as well as being a historical center. The city has an active arts scene, highlighted by the New Museum Los Gatos (NUMU) and annual events like "Music in the Park"

Los Gatos is a wine region with several notable wineries, including Testarossa Winery, Carmel Hill and David Bruce offering tastings and unique experiences.
host_about:
Our CEO, MaryJane was an executive with the Hyatt for seven years. She chose to leave the work force and stayed home to raise three boys! MaryJane fell into a job I loved, managing a Vacation Rental Company on the Monterey Peninsula and fell in LOVE with the idea of renting homes instead of Hotels. She left the company and started her own business to continue her passion for meeting people near and far and sharing the love of travel.

AirBnb had software problems, and had to recreate several of our listings,  under a second account.
